name: Rebekka Evans
headline: Practice Director
about: A dedicated and resourceful professional with over nine years of experience in the recruitment industry, recognized for reliability, hard work, and commitment to excellence. Throughout my career, I have refined my expertise in talent acquisition, candidate engagement, and delivering results, successfully connecting businesses with top-tier employees while fostering strong client and candidate relationships.

experiences.description:
OfficeTeam is the world's leading staffing service specializing in the placement of highly skilled office and administrative professionals into front office and administrative assistant jobs. With a global database of 2m+ highly skilled candidates, we have the resources, experience and expertise necessary to match highly skilled administrative professionals to our clients' hiring requirements. We can provide administrative support throughout an organization for positions including but not limited to:

Financial Recruiter Accountemps, the world’s first and largest specialized staffing service for temporary accounting, finance and bookkeeping professionals. We help businesses fill skills gaps by providing experienced professionals, and assist job seekers in finding rewarding career opportunities.

Experience

Accountemps places accounting and finance professionals on a temporary basis. We match highly skilled candidates with businesses requiring immediate, specialized assistance on a project basis and also provide individuals who can transition into full-time roles. This staffing model allows employers to access the talent they need, when they need it, and helps professionals further their careers. Accountemps has more than 330 offices around the world.

For 19 years, Robert Half, our parent company, has been named to Fortune® magazine’s list of “Most Admired Companies.” (March 1, 2017)

Mindfield is a recruitment solutions provider that partners with companies to create powerful hourly workforces. Our solutions combine professional recruiters, simple to use technology and a data-driven hiring strategy that promises to improve the quality of your hourly workforce.

This approach focuses on tying business outcomes such as sales performance, tenure, and engagement to the selection, hiring and measurement of quality candidates.

Security Watchdog is the industry leader and subject matter expert in all areas of global background checking, pre employment screening, criminal record checks and risk consultancy services. 

Since 1998 Security Watchdog has been at the forefront of the pre-employment screening industry, helping to establish best practice industry standards in the world of employee background checks and working with the then Criminal Records Bureau (CRB) to develop the eBulk software that now drives the DBS checking system.
